description: MOLRTDP (*multi-objective labeled RTDP*) plans when each action has a vector of costs. Each state's value is a set of cost vectors, the convex coverage set of the best trade-offs. Trials back up each state, pick a random greedy action with an unsolved successor, and sample a successor. The solved check of LRTDP then marks states solved, and the run ends when the start state is solved. It returns one deterministic *proper* policy (one that reaches a goal with probability 1) per vertex of the start state's set; use it when trials reach the relevant states faster than full passes.

papers.authors: Dillon Z. Chen, Felipe Trevizan, Sylvie Thiébaux
papers.title: Heuristic Search for Multi-Objective Probabilistic Planning
